roles.background: polarized VHS, Hodge loci, Gauss-Manin transport
roles.finding: Accept only on a contractible marked neighbourhood U and one reduced irreducible Hodge branch H; CDK calibrates the target but does not create witnesses. Monodromy must remain downstream.

roles.background: relative Hilbert schemes, flat families, deformation theory of subschemes
roles.finding: A finite product of fixed-polynomial relative Hilbert spaces is a legitimate proper source through a chosen tuple of integral components. Repeating factors handles multiplicity without a nonreduced-thickening assumption.

roles.background: cycle class maps, rational coefficients, algebraic equivalence
roles.finding: Clearing denominators and keeping signs external to the Hilbert factors preserves the exact signed-Q witness. The universal flat cycle class is locally constant on the connected source, so equality with N alpha at the central point propagates locally. C001 forbids replacing this coupled equality by componentwise Hodge persistence.

roles.background: variational Hodge conjecture and special families
roles.finding: Kloosterman's flag-Hilbert complete-intersection result is the correct positive structural calibration but has special geometry; no arbitrary-cycle transfer is allowed.

C006 and C007 force the conclusion to stop at proper exact-class source construction. The Hilbert source may be singular or vertical; properness does not imply dominance and tangent rank at a singular point is not enough.

The local contract is safe only before monodromy/global continuation. Crossing singular degeneration or continuing around loops is a distinct gluing problem, not evidence against the local construction.

roles.background: RAKL v3 authority, TaskEpisode/chronology, novelty accounting
roles.finding: The hypothesis predated durable freeze, so the episode is retrospective-only for discovery attribution. Store proposal/shadow, count no protected novelty, keep same-context review at 0/3 independent credit, and record the repeated pre-scratch chronology failure.

cell_consensus: PASS_SCOPED_PARTIAL_SUCCESS: exact signed-Q class binding plus proper branch-bound source is constructible from a chosen central algebraic witness; smoothness/direct dominance is the next local mathematical obstruction. No root promotion.
